description: A UI dialog fragment for conflict resolution in synchronization processes, allowing the user to choose how to resolve conflicts between local and remote data, with integrated analytics logging.

classes.name: ConflictResolutionDialog
classes.description: A DialogFragment subclass providing a user interface to resolve sync conflicts with options to keep local, keep remote, or merge, and logging user choices via analytics.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns the Dialog object displaying conflict resolution options, initializing analytics tracking.

methods.name: setOnResolveListener
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be invoked when the user selects a conflict resolution option.
